ordered_operations: reveal three Islands, Mountain, and Twinflame from the actual library
enumerate all legal unordered splits in the rules layer
ask the frozen opponent policy for a minimizing split
ask the frozen caster policy for a pile using current observation and combo context
move the chosen pile to hand and the other pile to graveyard
replay the recorded choices without policy code
preconditions: The scenario is constructed with build_exact_game().
The contextual_combo_v1 evaluator ID and SHA-256 are frozen before the choice.
Three lands are already controlled on Turn 3 and Dualcaster Mage is available.
required_assertions: the kernel does not contain card-value weights
the choice record contains evaluator ID and SHA-256
the three-excess-Island pile is not selected
fresh replay reproduces the exact recorded selection

plain_english: The exact frozen deck is placed in a Turn 3 state with three lands already on the battlefield and Dualcaster Mage available.
Fact or Fiction reveals three Islands, a Mountain, and Twinflame; the opponent selects a minimizing legal split using the frozen evaluator.
The caster's contextual policy keeps the pile containing Twinflame instead of selecting three excess Islands, and replay consumes the recorded choices without rerunning policy code.
title: Fact or Fiction uses a versioned contextual policy and keeps a missing combo piece over excess lands
